notes: NEW source-code verification of prior Goblinomics first-party capture lead; not an observed player study. `Modules/Workshop/Disenchant.lua` writes each captured successful disenchant to `GoblinomicsWorkshopDB.crafts` with fields id, time, char, recipe=13262, method=disenchant, crafts=1, input ItemKey (sometimes including bonus variant), outputs array of [output ItemKey,quantity], reagents, saved and incomplete. It joins ITEM_USE/ITEM_LOCK_CHANGED/ITEMS_DELTA with LOOT_RECEIVED from disenchant; ambiguous inputs may be nil/incomplete. CRITICAL censoring: `Disenchant.Flush` returns without a record if zero output events, so `crafts` is not a proof of all completed casts or zero-yield outcomes. `Salvage.Rows` calls ItemKey.Base(input), collapses different itemLink variants, and aggregates outputs/operations; require RAW crafts records, not UI rows, to retain 272246 ilvl/bonus distinctions. `CraftTracker.Flush` discards empty result buffers and can aggregate multiple crafts into one record (crafts >1) for prospecting/milling: never infer individual 0/1/2 stack histograms or true completed casts directly from such aggregates. Tests demonstrate both variant preservation at event level and collapsed display. Code has no demonstrated per-operation skill/specialization/actual game build snapshot; absent player-export, no 237362/237359/237365 rank-specific empirical casts, 242608 unlock outcomes or 236761 milling yields. Code and tests use synthetic IDs, which are NOT measured Midnight cohorts. Source links: https://github.com/xLN1995/goblinomics/blob/main/Modules/Workshop/CraftTracker.lua; https://github.com/xLN1995/goblinomics/blob/main/Modules/Workshop/Salvage.lua; https://github.com/xLN1995/goblinomics/blob/main/spec/workshop/disenchant_spec.lua; https://github.com/xLN1995/goblinomics/blob/main/spec/workshop/salvage_spec.lua. Sources on main read 2026-11-15; file blobs Disenchant=9a9853860aff9fbd0e8c2cb015131650a941eb80, Salvage=d2ce4e2091a4d9702340181aa53dca3ac6c06464, CraftTracker=675f36d77410a24671e624cd2eed3e848cf269dd.
